description: Fetch the full detail of ONE Teppek listing by listing_id. Use it after search_listings or semantic_search when the user picks a specific result and wants to see, summarize or compare it — e.g. "what is the salary on the second job?", "compare these two flats", "tell me more about that car". Do not use it to browse or count listings (use search_listings); you also do not need it just to show a result list, because search already returns the summary fields. Returns the listing object: id, title, description, price and currency (jobs also carry salary_min/salary_max), vertical, role, status, lat/lon and location_name, vertical-specific `attributes`, images, expires_at, deep_link (the contact or apply route) and the canonical teppek.com `url` the user can open. An unknown or removed id returns an error ("Listing not found") instead of a listing. Read-only and public — no authentication needed.

listing_id.description: Listing id, taken from the `id` field of search_listings, semantic_search or list_my_listings results. Example: "adzuna-us-5947308680".

name: get_listing
